people.imagined: Dawn on the south string above a frozen field. He has found the white bear's straw melting again in midwinter and says nothing; his split lip tightens against the wind as he coils the rope.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy ridge at dawn he looks down toward the paddock with narrowed eyes, deciding to say nothing, rope in hand; he has found the white bear's straw melting again in midwinter. Face: most important, a deep wind-split crack across his lower lip, red and plainly visible, and a thick coil of pale rope lying on his left shoulder. A lean, square-jawed face of about thirty-five, windburned brown, narrow pale-grey eyes with crow's feet, thick straight brows, a hooked nose, stubble on the jaw. Hair: thick black, caught in a high knot with a plain silver ring, a few strands whipped across the cheek. Body: wiry and rangy, stooped slightly against the wind. Clothing: fine riding robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk, two crossed collars embroidered with running horses in pale thread, a sky-blue gauze over-robe streaming in the wind, wide sleeves caught back at the wrist; a broad sash hung with a small white jade horse. Hands and objects: one broad hand, split at the knuckles and rope-burned on the palm, holds the end of the rope across his chest; the rope is thick pale hemp in loops the size of a plate, unravelled at one end. Power: faint motes of golden-brown earth light drift off his shoulders like dust in sun. Background: a pale winter sky and a blurred long line of grazing horses on frosted grass, drifting mist at the ridge. Light: cold silver dawn light from the upper left with a soft rim glow on the gauze, frost glittering at his feet. Expression: stubborn and brave, the tight mouth of a man who keeps his own counsel.

people.imagined: Spring, at the door of the Hall of Scales, ledger case clutched to her chest like a baby. She watches the reader of the account and thinks the joke has run long enough, and says nothing.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the door of a hall in spring, she cradles a flat lacquered case against her chest with both arms like a sleeping baby, patient and unwilling to speak. Face: most important, a flat dark wooden ledger case held in both arms, and a small round bronze ferry token with a square hole worn through her hair as a hairpin. A pleasant, round, tired face of about forty-five, olive skin, kind dark brown eyes with shadowed lids, thin level brows, a small nose, lips pressed in a polite line. Hair: black with a few grey strands, coiled in a low bun, the bronze token pinned through it beside a small silver ring. Body: stocky, upright, steady. Clothing: layered robes of soft grass-green and cloud-white silk with three crossed collars embroidered with clouds and running horses, a sky-blue gauze over-robe, cuffs of a deeper blue turned back neatly, a broad sash with a white jade horse and a small brass pen case. Hands and objects: both arms wrapped around the dark lacquered case with brass corners and a cord loop. Power: a faint blue-brown haze of water and earth qi hangs at her sleeves, a few pale motes rising. Background: a blurred pale wall of the Hall of Scales and a spring-green courtyard in light mist. Light: soft spring spirit-light from the upper left, gentle on her round cheek, a pale rim glow along the gauze. Expression: a patient, steady look, lips pressed together, eyes holding back a long-kept opinion.

people.imagined: A salt-carter's son in a stable at night, bargaining over a sack of the stable's spare oats and looking too pleased. One boot is a size too big and slides on his heel.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a stable doorway at dusk, grinning widely and holding up a sack of oats as if about to sell it. Face: most important, thick eyebrows salt-white as if powdered in a dark-skinned young face, and a tall riding boot visibly too big for his foot, wrinkling at the ankle. A broad, friendly, sun-darkened face of eighteen, snub nose, wide cheeks, bright brown eyes, a chatty gap-toothed grin. Hair: black, short and stiff with salt, sticking up, bound with a plain silver ring. Body: medium, sturdy, easygoing, leaning on one hip. Clothing: simple graceful robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk, open at the neck, two crossed collars with small running horses embroidered in white, a pale sky-blue gauze over-robe knotted loosely at the waist, salt dust speckling the sleeves, a sash with a small white jade horse. Hands and objects: a small cloth sack of oats tied with blue string hangs from one fist; the oversized brown boot is creased at the ankle, the other fits. Background: a dim stable with stalls, the softly glowing flank of a horse, a lantern, a drift of mist at the door. Light: warm lantern light from the lower left, cool moonlight rim on his shoulder. Expression: a wide, pleased grin with bright quick eyes and raised brows, hungry for a deal.

people.imagined: She sleeps beside the white bear in its straw, and wakes to a gentle huff. Straw in her hair, a hoof print on her apron, she sits calm and still while the herd decides about her.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on straw in a paddock at dawn, calm and still, one hand buried in thick white fur as the herd looks on, waking to the gentle huff of the white bear. Face: most important, bits of straw tangled in her hair, and a clear brown hoof print on the front of her pale outer robe, plainly visible; at her shoulder the edge of a great white bear's fur and one pale rounded ear edged in blue frost. A round, quiet, freckled face of sixteen, pale and pinked by cold, calm hazel eyes, straight light brows, a short nose, a gentle closed mouth. Hair: light brown, in a long braid with gold straw tangled in it, tied with a silver ring. Body: strong, sturdy and relaxed. Clothing: simple graceful robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk with crossed collars embroidered with tiny clouds, a sky-blue gauze over-robe pooled around her on the straw, a cloud-white outer robe carrying the horseshoe-curved hoof print in dried mud. Hands and objects: one freckled hand, scarred with old rope marks, sunk in the white fur; a faint blue frost shimmer around the fur. Power: a few soft blue motes of water qi drift from the fur to her sleeve. Background: a blurred paddock fence silver with dew, mist at dawn. Light: pale blue-gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left, soft rim glow on her braid. Expression: calm and compassionate, a stubborn steady patience, as if she could sit there until the herd decides about her.

people.imagined: She has just won a race again, and slides from the saddle with the colt already forgotten. She tells her rival the colts were stolen. The gloves and the studs are all anyone sees.
people.subject: The moment: just back from a race, flushed and breathless, she looks sideways with a hard bright smile that is slightly too sharp. Face: most important, a ring of five small bronze studs running around the rim of her left ear, each with a pin-prick of light, and riding gloves cut off at the fingertips, held up near her chin. A strong, pointed face of twenty, tan with a flush, narrow green-brown eyes, sharp arched brows, a straight nose, thin lips in a hard smile. Hair: dark chestnut, short at the neck and wind-tangled, held by a silk headband with a silver ring. Body: lean, athletic, forward-leaning. Clothing: a close-cut riding robe of grass-green and cloud-white silk with a standing double collar embroidered with running horses, a sky-blue gauze over-robe tied back at the shoulders so it streams behind her, a red race sash at the waist dark with sweat, a white jade horse at the sash. Hands and objects: both hands near her chin, bare fingertips showing from the tan gloves. Power: faint blue-green motes of wind and water swirl at her shoulder like spray. Background: a blurred race track in pale mist, a horse's head at the edge, the dust behind glowing pale gold. Light: bright silver spirit-light from the upper left with a hard rim glow on her cheekbone. Expression: a hard, bright smile a little too sharp, flushed cheeks and a cold flicker in the eyes.

people.imagined: The herd boy stands in the paddock after an hour late, rubbing the back of his neck, thinking of the old horse he wants. He has sold the ride for a purse and is fidgeting.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a paddock gate, he rubs the back of his neck and shifts his weight, looking everywhere but at the viewer, uneasy after a bargain. Face: most important, bow legs, shown in the stance of his hips and the way his robe hangs, and the hand rubbing the back of his neck. A thin, restless, boyish face of nineteen, light brown skin, light hazel eyes that slide sideways, sparse eyebrows, a long nose, a half-grin that comes and goes. Hair: short brown, sticking up at the crown under a thin silver ring. Body: short, wiry and bandy-legged, knees standing out like hoop bars. Clothing: graceful riding robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk, sleeves a little too long, two crossed collars with tiny embroidered horses, a pale sky-blue gauze over-robe, a thick white silk scarf; a small purse of dull red cloth with a drawstring half hidden under the sash beside a white jade horse. Hands and objects: one hand behind his neck, the other plucking a thread at his cuff. Power: a faint tan haze of earth qi at his hem. Background: a blurred paddock fence, tall silvered grass, a white horse standing motionless in the mist like a statue. Light: late golden spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim glow on his ears. Expression: guilty, darting eyes that avoid the viewer, a tight uneasy mouth and a flush at the neck.

people.imagined: At a writing desk, copying a letter for the second time. Her thumb is black with ink. She has read the offer and knows what it would be called, and she keeps her face still.
people.subject: The moment: at a writing desk, she pauses with a brush above the paper, listening for footsteps, copying a letter a second time in secret. Face: most important, the pad of her right thumb is solid ink-black, held against the brush shaft, and her writing hand slants the wrong way, backward like a left-hander's. A narrow, bookish, pale face of twenty-three, dark steady eyes, thin level brows, a small nose, a controlled neutral mouth. Hair: black, in a smooth low knot with a single wooden pin and a small silver ring. Body: slight, upright, neat. Clothing: soft robes of cloud-white and grass-green silk with a high plain double collar, narrow sleeves with pale blue cuffs held by plain sleeve garters, a sky-blue gauze over-robe, a slim sash with a small white jade horse. Hands and objects: one hand on the brush, held in the odd upside-down grip, the other flat on a sheet of blank paper. Power: a faint blue-grey draught of wind-qi stirs the paper and the hem of her gauze. Background: a blurred window of pale paper with thin dark mullions, an unlit lamp on a shelf, mist at the sill. Light: cool silver moonlight from the upper left, soft rim glow on her cheek. Expression: a still, careful face with lowered eyes and a closed mouth, the brow tight and the ears seeming to listen.

people.imagined: She stands facing the wind from the steppe, out of habit, left hand tucked in her sleeve, the frostbitten one. She is thinking of the abbey of six people and how to light it again.
people.subject: The moment: on an open steppe edge, she faces directly into the wind with her chin lifted, robes streaming, her left hand hidden in her sleeve. Face: most important, a long narrow weathered face turned into the wind with eyes narrowed, a strand of old grey-blue abbey cloth at her collar, and the frostbitten left hand tucked in the sleeve, only its blue-white fingertips showing. About sixty, windburned brown skin with fine deep lines, light grey eyes, thin grey brows, a narrow straight nose, a firm thin mouth. Hair: iron grey, in a tight high knot with a ram-horn pin and a silver ring. Body: narrow, upright, spare. Clothing: an elder's richest robes of grass-green and cloud-white brocade embroidered with running horses and clouds, over a grey-blue pleated abbey habit mended with fine stitches, a long sky-blue gauze over-robe flattened and streaming sideways in the wind, a broad sash with a white jade horse; a ram's-horn pennant of undyed wool tied at the left shoulder. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small plumb line of well-digger's cord, its dark lead weight hanging; the frostbitten fingertips are waxy blue-white and stiff. Power: a strong pale-gold aura of earth qi lies round her like sunlit dust, with a pale wind streak across the frame. Background: an empty pale sky over wind-combed grass, drifting mist. Light: cold bright silver light from the upper left, a glowing rim on her grey hair. Expression: a calm, lifted face with narrowed eyes and a quiet, determined mouth.

people.imagined: A herd master at the north paddock fence, staring at the white bear that upsets the mares. His lip is split and his hands like saddle leather. He is certain of one thing.
people.subject: The moment: at a fence rail, he glares across a paddock at the white bear that upsets the mares, jaw set. Face: most important, a lip split by a mare's hoof, a thick white scar down through the lower lip that pulls the mouth slightly to one side, and enormous cracked hands like saddle leather gripping the rail, a fingernail missing from the left thumb. Appearing about fifty, deeply tanned and lined, small hard grey eyes, heavy grey eyebrows, a broad flat nose, a wide stubborn mouth. Hair: grey, cropped short beneath a silver-ringed headband of cloud-white silk. Body: short, strongly bow-legged, thick forearms. Clothing: an elder's richest riding robes of grass-green and cloud-white brocade with running horses embroidered in silver, a deep sky-blue gauze over-robe with a wide collar, fine forearm guards of silk and lacquer, a broad sash with a white jade horse; a festival ribbon tied around his upper arm, bleached to pink. Hands and objects: both hands on the rail, knuckles scarred; beside him, her head over the rail at his shoulder, stands his horse Hồng Tông, a short-coupled chestnut spirit mare with a mane like a grass fire. Power: a heavy pale-gold aura of earth qi lies about him, motes drifting from the mare's mane. Background: a blurred paddock, mares at the fence, a pale spring field in mist. Light: hard silver-gold spirit-light from the upper left, a rim glow on the mare's mane. Expression: a hard glare with a set jaw, a split lip and deep creases beside the eyes, completely certain.

people.imagined: Sunset at the steward's desk, sealing the year's corrected account, signed as Lạc Hà's own custom asks. A reed pen behind her ear. She does the sum quietly, and waits.
people.subject: The moment: at a steward's desk at sunset, she seals a folded sheet with a heavy stamp, calm and unhurried, doing the year's corrected sum quietly and waiting. Face: most important, a reed pen tucked behind her right ear, a pale split reed with an ink-dark tip, and both cuffs stained blue-black with ink, clear in the frame. About forty-five in looks, a broad, quiet, level face, brown skin, steady dark eyes, strong straight brows, a broad nose, a calm closed mouth. Hair: black with a streak of grey, in a tight high knot with a silver ring. Body: broad, sturdy and still. Clothing: an elder's rich robes of grass-green and cloud-white brocade with high crossed collars embroidered with running horses, a sky-blue gauze over-robe with ink-stained blue cuffs, a broad sash with a white jade horse and a ring of small bronze keys. Hands and objects: both broad hands press a stamp, a block of brown wood with a worn brass band, onto a fold of paper. Power: a soft earth-brown glow in the air and a thin blue ripple of water qi round the paper. Background: a blurred room with a window full of amber sunset, the wall turned apricot, a light mist. Light: low gold sunset spirit-light from the left, warming the paper under her hands, rim glow on her sleeve. Expression: just and patient, pragmatic, the settled face of someone who has already weighed the account and will wait for the others to catch up.

people.imagined: He stands in a stance no push can shift, in the outer yard, teaching stable boys to stand like a mountain. He is content, with the face of a man who found his place.
people.subject: The moment: in a wide low stance he holds still with a mild smile while unseen boys try to push him, teaching stable boys to stand like a mountain. Face: most important, a completely shaven bare head with a high shining dome, faintly stubbled, and heavy square shoulders filling the width of the frame. About forty-five, a round, calm, brown face, small kind dark eyes, thick black straight eyebrows, a thick flat nose, a placid smile. Body: very broad, thick-necked and immovable. Clothing: robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk worn open over a grey-blue abbey habit of soft old silk neatly mended at the cuff, two crossed collars embroidered with clouds, a sky-blue gauze over-robe hanging heavy from his shoulders, a plain cord sash with a small white jade horse. Hands and objects: both fists resting at his hips, thumbs tucked in, each as thick as a woman's wrist. Power: a heavy tan-gold haze of earth qi gathers at his feet, the packed earth faintly glowing, motes of dust rising slowly. Background: a yard of packed earth pale with scuff-marks of boys' feet, a blurred fence and soft shapes of boys in mist. Light: bright pearly spirit-light from the upper left, shining on the shaved dome. Expression: humble and patient, content, the unhurried, easy face of a man who found his place and has no wish to be shifted from it.

people.imagined: The victor of the festival, grinning wide, a ribbon braided into her hair. She has the look of a rider about to race anyone, anywhere, and win on the third lap.
people.subject: The moment: grinning widely from the saddle just after a win, chin raised, challenging the viewer to race anyone, anywhere, and win on the third lap. Face: most important, a crooked broken nose flattened and bent to one side, and a faded red festival ribbon braided into her hair. A wiry, sun-browned face of about thirty-five, bright dark eyes, thick quick brows, a gap-toothed wide smile with a chipped front tooth, a small white nick of a scar on the chin. Hair: black, in a long braid over one shoulder with the red ribbon woven through and knotted at the end, a silver ring at the root. Body: lean, hard and forward-leaning. Clothing: close-cut riding robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk with a red collar band and tiny running horses embroidered along the double collar, a sky-blue gauze over-robe tied back and fluttering, silver studs; a fine glove on one hand. Hands and objects: the other glove pulled half off with her teeth, tooth marks on its cuff; a white jade horse at her sash. Power: swirls of green-gold wind and dust curl round her shoulders. Background: a blurred race track and cheering crowd in mist, soft colour blurs and unlettered pennants. Light: bright festival spirit-light from the upper left, a glowing rim on her braid. Expression: arrogant and impatient, delighted, a challenging, wide-open grin that dares anyone to ride beside her.

people.imagined: A merchant's grandson in a silk riding coat rained on twice but uncreased, boasting about the horse he picked, charging a copper for the saddling.
people.subject: The moment: leaning against a stall, he boasts with a wide easy smile and holds out a hand for a copper coin, charging for the saddling of the horse he picked. Face: most important, a fine silk riding robe of rich dark wine red, rain-spotted twice but creaseless where the saddle should have worn it, with a gold-thread button at the neck bright as a coin. A plump, handsome, lazy face of twenty-one, smooth pale skin, sleepy brown eyes, neat black eyebrows, a small nose, a charming smile. Hair: black, oiled and combed, tied back with a silk ribbon and a silver ring. Body: soft and loosely built, leaning his whole weight on the stall. Clothing: the wine-red silk robe woven with tiny clouds, over cloud-white inner collars embroidered with running horses, a sky-blue gauze over-robe with dull round rain spots on the shoulder, a jade-green belt with a white jade horse, polished unscuffed boots. Hands and objects: one hand palm up, a single copper coin shining on it. Power: a pale silver-white shimmer of metal qi plays on his buttons and coin. Background: a blurred stable row with a bay horse craning its neck, a row of horses' heads in soft mist. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left, bright on the gold thread. Expression: lazy and gregarious, a greedy glint behind the easy smile, the look of a merchant's grandson who expects to be paid for everything.

people.imagined: A ford orphan with a rower's shoulders tells the stable boys he beat his old teacher. A pink burn patch on his chin shines. He eats cheese that is not his.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a hay bale, he waves a piece of cheese and tells a boastful story with a flushed face and bright eyes. Face: most important, a pink burn-patch on his chin, shiny and tight, the size of a thumb, a scatter of freckles over his cheeks, and wide rower's shoulders. A square, freckled face of nineteen, ruddy skin, fierce light brown eyes, heavy red-brown brows, a short nose, a grin that tips into a scowl. Hair: ginger-brown, cropped short with a cowlick, tied with a silver ring at a short knot. Body: broad-shouldered, thick-armed, short in the leg. Clothing: simple graceful robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk, a red band at the double collar embroidered with small horses, sleeves rolled to the elbow showing rope-callused forearms, a thin sky-blue gauze over-robe slipping off one shoulder. Hands and objects: a crumbling wedge of pale cheese in one fist, crumbs at his lip. Power: a faint red-orange warmth of fire qi glows near his chin. Background: a blurred hay barn and stable boys, golden dusty motes drifting in the mist. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left, hay chaff glittering in his hair. Expression: a flushed, boastful grin with bright, quick eyes and raised brows.

people.imagined: She plays the herd home at dusk on a reed pipe, humming through her nose between phrases. The mares answer her before the herd call.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk with a reed pipe held at her chest, she hums through her nose between phrases, eyes half closed, content. Face: most important, a short reed pipe hanging on a red thread around her neck, large and clear against her robe, and her hand holding it. A soft, round, shy face of sixteen, light olive skin, long dark lashes, thin gentle brows, a small nose, a closed humming mouth. Hair: black, in two low braids with red thread woven in, a small silver ring at each. Body: small, slender, relaxed. Clothing: soft robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk with a round double collar embroidered with running horses, a white silk scarf, a pale sky-blue gauze over-robe lifting in the dusk air, a sash with a small white jade horse. Hands and objects: both small fingers, reed-stained ink-brown, hold the pale yellow pipe with four neat holes and a wrap of red thread at the mouthpiece. Power: a faint green-gold sheen of wood qi gathers in the air round the pipe, a few motes floating like fireflies. Background: a blurred dusk plain with the dark rumps of mares walking home, early stars, soft mist. Light: lilac dusk spirit-light with a warm glow from the upper left, a gentle rim on her braids. Expression: closed, half-lidded eyes and a content hum with lips pursed, the face calm and gentle.

people.imagined: He has a bandaged hand from the mare that threw him, and stares at the viewer with his grandfather's slow stare. He wants a horse that will not have him.
people.subject: The moment: he stands stiff in a paddock gate, glaring slowly at the viewer, a bandaged hand held up before his chest, bitten by the mare that threw him; he wants a horse that will not have him. Face: most important, a thickly bandaged right hand with a rust stain showing through at the knuckles, held up, and a slow, heavy stare copied from his grandfather. A heavy, handsome, sulky face of eighteen, brown, dark deep-set eyes, thick straight brows, a strong nose, a tight mouth. Hair: black, oiled, in a stiff high topknot with a new festival ribbon and a silver ring. Body: tall, stocky, broad in the jaw. Clothing: fine robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk with a dark blue cuff and two crossed collars embroidered with running horses, a pale grey fur collar, a sky-blue gauze over-robe, a broad sash with a white jade horse. Hands and objects: the thick linen bandage wound in layers and tied at the wrist; the other fist grips a neatly coiled halter rope. Power: a faint tan-gold haze of earth qi and a thin green thread of wood qi curl round the bandage. Background: a blurred paddock fence, a grey mare watching from behind it in mist. Light: harsh silver spirit-light from the upper left, flat on the pale linen, a cold rim on his jaw. Expression: ambitious and impatient, a cruel, sulky set to the mouth, the stare of a boy who has decided to be a harder man than he is.

people.imagined: A groom of thirty years sits in the white bear's straw, packing it with river ice. His shoulders are uneven from carrying two buckets. He smells of cold water.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in straw with an armful of river ice, an old groom looks up quietly, a thick white fur beside him; for thirty years he has packed the white bear's straw with ice. A servant, so plainer, but clean. Face: most important, uneven shoulders, the left one dropped noticeably lower than the right, a wooden yoke dark with years of sweat across his neck, and two ash-wood iron-banded buckets at the frame's edge, one dripping. A lined, gentle, stubborn face of fifty-five, weathered brown, small pale-blue eyes, thick grey brows, a bulbous nose, a closed kind mouth. Hair: thin grey, tied in a short tail under a plain cloud-white cap. Body: wide and bent, with strong arms. Clothing: a groom's plain robe of clean grass-green silk-cotton with sleeves rolled, a pale cloud-white undershirt with a crossed collar, a simple belt and a pale sky-blue gauze apron-cloth, no jewellery. Hands and objects: both big knuckled hands cradle two blocks of pale blue river ice that steam faintly; the white bear's thick fur shows at his elbow. Power: none but the cold; a faint blue frost shimmer rises from the ice. Background: a paddock in drifting mist, cold straw. Light: cool blue-white spirit-light from the upper left, frost glittering on the straw. Expression: compassionate and stubborn, reclusive, the quiet patient face of a man who smells of cold water and has no wish to be anywhere else.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the age he gathered the plain's horse families into one manor, a tall herder with a cloud-white beard braided like a mane.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of the founder at the age he gathered the plain's horse families into one manor, a tall herder standing proud among horses with calm generous eyes. Face: most important, a long cloud-white beard braided in a thick plait like a horse's mane, falling to his chest, tied at its end with a thong and a bead. A long, lined, kindly face of about fifty-five, weathered brown, deep-set grey eyes, white shaggy brows, a high-bridged nose, a calm mouth. Hair: white, long, tied with a festival ribbon under a small silver crown. Body: tall, long-limbed, very upright. Clothing: the founder's grand old-style robes of grass-green and cloud-white brocade embroidered with running horses and clouds, a sky-blue gauze over-robe falling to the ground, a broad sash with a white jade horse, a rope belt; a herder's long crook of smooth dark wood with a curved head tucked under one arm. Power: a faint brown cloud-like haze of earth qi about him, pale smudges of galloping horses behind like clouds. Background: a pale cloudy sky over a plain, soft mist. Light: soft pale spirit-glow from the upper left; the whole picture slightly faded, soft-edged and yellowed like old silk, the edges darkened. Expression: a calm, kindly face with generous steady eyes and a quiet smile in the cloud-white beard.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the herder who was shorted three stones at the horse fair and forgave it the same day. He wears a mended felt cap and looks mildly at the viewer.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded like old silk, of a gaunt herder with a patient stoop, looking mildly out as if he has just forgiven someone: he was shorted three stones at the horse fair and forgave it the same day. Face: most important, a mended cap of cloud-white silk, its crown mended with a square of reddish silk in a different shade and stitched in coarse black thread, and a gaunt, gentle face. About forty-five, thin, lined, weather-browned, mild dark eyes, thin brows, a long nose, a small forgiving smile. Hair: grey-black and short, under the cap. Body: tall, thin, round-shouldered. Clothing: carefully mended robes of grass-green and cloud-white silk with horn-coloured toggles, three different shades across one elbow, two crossed collars with faint embroidered horses, a pale sky-blue gauze over-robe, a woven belt with a small white jade horse; the mending is a herder's neat habit, not poverty. Hands and objects: one hand holds a halter rope loosely. Power: a faint tan haze of earth qi around the rope. Background: a pale plain with a distant tent as a pale triangle and faint horse shapes in mist. Light: a soft pale spirit-glow from the upper left; the whole picture slightly faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. Expression: a mild, unhurt gaze with soft eyes and a gentle slack mouth, nothing asked of the viewer.
